page.layout: One column of running text. Running head at the top, with the page number printed at its right. No notes in the margins; the marks there are handwriting. No catchword or signature.

main_text.l: fum. Q. An sit? R. Quia per-
duellio est, qui sua sponte ma-
gistratum violat. at ego si vio
F. Imò perduellio est, qui sine

page.notes: Reading of the running head: the first letters are set in a long-s style glyph, read as IVRISCONSULTUS. Spelling "ciuem", "siue", "uiolat" and "uio lauí" normalised to u/v by the rule; the printed forms are close to these. "lauí" is read as lavi, a doubtful reading. "uio" is read as vio, a doubtful reading. Handwriting in the margin next to "Intentio" and small ink dots by "omniũ" are not printed text and are left out.
